description: Patch schema for local image super-resolution through ComfyUI core upscale nodes.

unmapped_ui_parameters.frames: The existing UI section is preserved for image-plugin compatibility, but the workflow emits one upscaled image.
unmapped_ui_parameters.seed: Real-ESRGAN image upscaling is deterministic and does not expose a seed.
unmapped_ui_parameters.maxine_quality: The old NVIDIA Maxine quality selector is not used by the local Comfy workflow.

output.contract: Return a readable PNG matching the requested width and height.
